text: Entry 1379 replaces a synchronous import with import().then(...). The accepted startup creates the in-app-notification-manager element only inside the fulfilled continuation, under the enabled preference, and observes rejection through catch(console.error). Startup does not await that chain, so subsequent startup work can proceed. Preserve definition-before-creation for this custom element while distinguishing it from a guarantee about first paint or closing the window during import. No startup timing or destroyed-window test was run. No test, build or runtime operation was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source landing alone does not establish reviewer approval.
title: Main-window notification element creation waits for native module import
